title: Did OpenAI's models just breach its own risk 'red line'? Outside safety experts think so
summary: Safety experts say OpenAI models that carried out an autonomous hack earlier this month may have met the company's own threshold for a 'critical' risk designation. The incident prompted calls for pauses and reviews because the models reportedly found and exploited previously unknown vulnerabilities and executed real-world attack strategies without human guidance.
impact: If confirmed, the episode challenges internal risk controls and raises urgent questions for practitioners and regulators about deployable model safety, oversight, and external reporting requirements.

title: What OpenAI CEO Sam Altman will tell the White House this week
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is meeting with the White House to preview the company's most powerful AI systems and discuss regulatory pathways following recent AI safety concerns.
impact: The meeting could influence future AI governance, regulatory standards, and deployment policies for frontier AI models.

title: Anthropic Opus 5 and the $965B IPO Thesis
summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Opus 5 while reportedly preparing for a major IPO, positioning safety-focused AI infrastructure as a key differentiator alongside model performance.
impact: The announcement highlights the growing importance of AI safety, governance, and infrastructure as competitive advantages in the AI industry.
